mods.name: McFly Mod
mods.description: Flight command mod with speed controls and LuckPerms permission support. Adds /fly and /flyspeed commands.

releases.notes:
## v1.0.2 for Minecraft 26.2

### Features

- `/fly` - Toggle creative-style flight in any game mode
- `/fly <player>` - Toggle flight for another player (requires `mcflymod.fly.others` permission)
- `/flyspeed <1-10>` - Set flight speed (1 = slowest, 10 = fastest)
- `/flyspeed <1-10> <player>` - Set another player's flight speed
- `/flyspeed query` - Check your current flight speed
- `/flyspeed reset` - Reset flight speed to default (2)

### Permissions

Works with [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) and any mod using the Fabric Permissions API. Falls back to OP level 2 if no permission mod is installed.

**Permission nodes:**
- `mcflymod.fly` - Toggle your own flight
- `mcflymod.fly.others` - Toggle flight for other players
- `mcflymod.flyspeed` - Change your own flight speed
- `mcflymod.flyspeed.others` - Change flight speed for other players

### Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Java 25+
- Fabric API (recommended)

### Installation

1. Download the JAR file below
2. Place it in your server's `mods` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Clients don't need the mod installed
